explanation: A Jewish woman who became queen of Persia and the main character in the book of Esther.
Esther's adoptive father and a central figure in the story, who helps her save the Jewish people.
A high-ranking Persian official who seeks to destroy the Jews but is ultimately punished for his evil plans.
The king of Persia, also known as Xerxes, who is married to Esther and plays a key role in the story.
A Jewish festival celebrated in remembrance of the events in the book of Esther, when the Jews were saved from Haman's wicked plot.
An official order or law, especially one issued by a king or other authority.
A tall pole or structure used to hang people as a form of execution. In the book of Esther, it is Haman who is hanged on the gallows he had built for Mordecai.
